title: Website Screenshot - PNG, Mobile Viewports & 网页截图
description: Minimal input: {"startUrls": ["https://example.com"], "width": 1440, "height": 900, "fullPage": true}. One paid row per screenshot.

startUrls.title: startUrls
startUrls.description: Public HTTP(S) website URLs, e.g. ["https://example.com"]. Up to 100. No credentials or private-network URLs. One target may yield multiple contacts only in Email Finder.

width.title: width
width.description: Viewport width in CSS pixels, 320–1920. Default 1440. Example: 390 for a mobile-sized page, without mobile device emulation.

height.title: height
height.description: Viewport height in CSS pixels, 320–1080. Default 900. Used for viewport screenshots; full-page screenshots can be taller.

fullPage.title: fullPage
fullPage.description: true (default) captures the full page up to 12,000 pixels tall; false captures the viewport. One screenshot price either way; height_capped reports clipping.

maxResults.title: maxResults
maxResults.description: Maximum paid rows across the run, 1–1000, default 20. Example: 3 for a sample. Exclusions and empty results apply before the cap.

excludeIds.title: excludeIds
excludeIds.description: Prior output id values to skip before billing, up to 5,000. Empty [] disables. Suppresses that identity even if content changed.

excludeContentHashes.title: excludeContentHashes
excludeContentHashes.description: Prior output content_hash values (64 lowercase hex characters), up to 5,000. Empty [] disables. Matching snapshots are skipped before billing.
